label: Modicon M241 24 I/O logic controller
description: Modicon M241 logic controller with 14 DI / 10 transistor DO and one 10/100BASE-TX RJ45 Ethernet port that carries Modbus TCP server/client and EtherNet/IP. Serial 1 is an RJ45 RS-232/RS-485 link and serial 2 an RS-485 terminal block; the mini-B USB port is programming only.
